subject.title: [Bug] Sandbox validateEnvVarValue base64 heuristic false-positives on legitimate long alphanumeric values

question: Should OpenClaw narrow the sandbox env credential-data warning so structured base64-like values warn only on credential-looking environment names?
rationale: The false positive is source-reproducible, but reducing advisory credential-warning coverage changes a sandbox/security tradeoff that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Approve key-aware warning policy
options.body: Refresh the linked PR onto current main, port the skill runtime caller, and land the narrower heuristic after sandbox/security review.

options.title: Preserve broader warning coverage
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a different heuristic that reduces false positives without relying on credential-looking names.

options.title: Close as intentional policy
options.body: If broad warnings are preferred for sandbox safety, close this issue as intentional conservative behavior and document that policy.

recommendation.title: Approve key-aware warning policy
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR onto current main, port the skill runtime caller, and land the narrower heuristic after sandbox/security review.
